responsibility: Declares the `Runtime` helper class and generated `Function` enumeration that identify runtime routines used by lowered Go code. It exposes the frontend API for constructing runtime call expressions, converting runtime-related types to backend form, and mapping named builtins/runtime helpers back to runtime function codes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `Runtime` helper API and the generated `Function` enumeration produced from `runtime.def`, so other frontend code can refer to runtime helpers abstractly. Unlike `runtime.def`, it is not the catalog itself, and unlike `runtime.cc`, it does not build signatures or calls—it only exposes that service.
